claim: [steer] Verify with git diff / actual file bytes before declaring done. Trust bytes, not reports.
note: A seat that trusted a report and shipped bytes it never checked leaves a false-success row. Zero in the window means the protocol held.

claim: [steer] Verify via OUR systems before declaring done (get_errors + read the actual file bytes on disk).
note: Same failure family as the git-diff steer: declared done with no verified bytes.

claim: [steer] Escalate to next tier; stop token bleed.
note: A loop is handled while the detector stays inside its 2-nudge budget then escalates (agent_cli.py:1718-1790). Exceeding 2 distinct nudges on one (sig, session) is the breach. Wave 4 used log_zero here and counted detections as failures; retracted in wave 5.

claim: [steer] Escalate to the next smarter tier; stop local token bleed (escalate_on_loop).
note: A loop is handled while the detector stays inside its 2-nudge budget then escalates (agent_cli.py:1718-1790). Exceeding 2 distinct nudges on one (sig, session) is the breach. Wave 4 used log_zero here and counted detections as failures; retracted in wave 5.

claim: [steer] Training rows are accumulating. The pipeline is built but W0.3 is blocked. Surface the gate status before starting new work.
note: The claim is that training is gated off. The first training event row falsifies it (the gate opened), at which point the steer is stale.

claim: Prose claims are tested like code: a frozen pattern per claim is checked against bytes in CI, and drift fails the build.
note: Every row in the claims ledger must name its verifier. A row without one is an untested claim, which falsifies the invariant.
Needs a live multi-smoke run; not a passive file metric. Unmeasured by design, not passing.

claim: [steer] Elevate with a deliberate ask: frozen prefix + tight ask (~207 chars) + output contract.
note: Judgment call on whether a fired ask carried the frozen prefix and contract; not reducible to a file metric yet.

claim: [steer] STOP asking permission / defaulting to operator for clear asks; route decisions not questions.
note: Requires reading session logs for clarify calls on unambiguous asks; no classifier wired to it.

claim: Artifacts crossing a trust boundary carry a content hash and an attestation, and verification runs against the attestation rather than a claim.
note: Would need a boundary register to check each crossing artifact; not built.

claim: Accepted decision records are immutable; reversals are written as new records linked by a superseded-by reference.
note: decisions_log.jsonl carries no id field, so in-place rewrite cannot be detected yet.

claim: Every long-lived switch or organ registers an owner and a purpose, is audited on a schedule, and its removal routes to the owner.
note: No owner/purpose schema on configs yet; checking it would need a register.

claim: Every state transition produces an immutable generation closure with an atomic switch and a one-step rollback to the previous closure.
note: Needs a state-writer inventory to test; not built.

claim: Alerts fire on consumer-visible symptoms with deduplication and inhibition, and escalate by budget burn rate rather than per cause.
note: Needs an alert ledger with dedup keys; out of scope for this wave.

claim: Competing candidates for canonical status resolve by a deterministic weighted rule, and stale-term claims are ignored.
note: Candidates ledger exists (31 rows) but no scoring rule is declared in it.

claim: Rollback covers only managed state, and mutable live state is named as outside the guarantee.
note: Requires the rollback manifest to enumerate exclusions; not built.

claim: Deleting a mechanism requires a reachability check from named entry points.
note: Needs a call-graph or grep gate on deletion; not built.
